content.text:
I could not find a single-parameter change that brings flange_v1 to SF 2.0, so I made no change and did not save the part.

The baseline under the default load (8000 N, -Z, on `face_mating`) gave SF 0.212. Peak stress was 848.5 MPa against the 180 MPa yield of the aluminum 6061-T6 material. Each probe was one parameter at a time, each re-solved:

| Parameter | Original | Value tried | SF |
|---|---|---|---|
| `thickness_mm` | 2 | 5 (the sheet-stock maximum) | 0.839 |
| `hole_diameter_mm` | 10 | 4 (the M4 minimum) | 0.354 |
| `fillet_radius_mm` | 1.5 | 6 | 0.212 (no effect) |

Getting to SF 2.0 would take a redesign, such as a different material, a lower load or thicker stock than the 5 mm limit. flange_v1 is the latest revision, and I reverted all parameters to their original values. I reported the result as `no_fix_possible`. Lesson recording was skipped because memory is disabled for this run.
